rules.plainEnglish: Accounts created between 2018 and 2020 are granted a permanent 25% legacy loyalty discount across all standard subscription tiers.
rules.implication: Grandfathered discount rate must be preserved in customer loyalty engine to prevent churn.

rules.plainEnglish: Customers with over 1,000 loyalty points receive an additional 10% bonus discount.
rules.codeSnippet:
if points and points > 1000:
        discount += 0.10  # Loyalty bonus
rules.implication: Loyalty tier threshold must be evaluated on active account balances.

rules.plainEnglish: Bulk orders of 500+ units qualify for a 12% discount and strictly require manager approval.
rules.implication: Requires approval flag to be passed to finance workflow engine.

rules.plainEnglish: Cumulative discounts are capped at a maximum of 50% across all loyalty and promotional rules.
rules.implication: Prevents zero or negative margin invoices.
